plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-16 by live browser from Bakersfield College's official Program Pathways Mapper (https://programmap.bakersfieldcollege.edu/, reached from the college's official program-mapper page; no login required or attempted). The map is headed 'Industrial Automation map for 2025-2026' and the pathway is for catalog year 2025-2026. Source map URL is this plan's source_url. Card View and Table View agreed exactly on every row. CATALOG-YEAR DISCLOSURE: the mapper publishes NO detailed map for the Industrial Automation Bachelor of Science in catalog year 2026-2027 — the 2026-2027 program page states verbatim: 'We don't have detailed information about different pathways or courses for this program.' This plan therefore transcribes the program's only detailed map, its 2025-2026 pathway 'Industrial Automation / Bachelor of Science / 118-121 units / 8 terms / to Career', in full, and is labeled catalog_year 2025-2026; it is not a 2026-2027 map. The mapper lists Industrial Automation as three separate credentials (Bachelor of Science, Associate of Science, Certificate of Achievement); this plan is the Bachelor of Science only. The map prints the degree total as a range, 118-121 units, and term totals as 15-15.5 / 16-16.5 / 16 / 12-14 / 15 / 15 / 12 / 17. Ranged rows: Term 1 'ENGL B1A or ENGL B1AL' (3-3.5); Term 2 'MATH B1A or MATH B1AL' (4-4.5); Term 4 'Industrial Automation Elective' (2-4). Per the standing minimum-credit convention every ranged row is recorded at its printed minimum, so every term sum equals the map's printed term total at its minimum and the plan total is the printed minimum of 118 units. Rows printed with a 'Prerequisites' flag in Card View (Term 2: ELET B4, ELET B1B; Term 3: ELET B55A, ELET B58, PHYS B2A; Term 4: ELET B61, ELET B56, AUTO B11; Term 5: INDA B110; Term 6: INDA B105, INDA B120; Term 7: INDA B122; Term 8: INDA B150) carry the flag disclosure on the row; the map does not print the specific prerequisite courses, so no prereqs are recorded. No Corequisites or Dual Enrollment flags appear. The 'ENGL B1A or ENGL B1AL', 'MATH B1A or MATH B1AL', 'HIST B17A or HIST B17B', 'ECON B1 or ECON B2', 'Industrial Automation Elective' and 'Spanish' rows are transcribed exactly as printed as unselected 'Choose a course from ...' choice slots; the option lists behind those slots are not enumerated. INDR B12 (Term 1) is printed with the category label 'Elective' and is recorded with category 'elective'; all other named courses printed 'General Education' are recorded as 'core' and those printed 'Major' as 'major'. No milestone rows are printed on this map. The map page states verbatim: 'This program map represents one possible pathway through the program and may not reflect the most current catalog requirements. Make an appointment to create a customized education plan that fits your needs.'
